iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA board passed a reporting and verification resolution; Iran still has unresolved uranium stocks enriched up to 60 percent and IAEA access/inspection demands remain unmet while U.S.-allied sanctions-relief terms harden.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: BBC, NYT and Washington Post report a U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal appears within reach and Hormuz reopening would follow implementation; until then Hormuz closed/restricted posture and recent strike cycle keep the conventional-war track imminent but easing.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Al Jazeera and regional outlets report Israel hit south Lebanon, issued forced-displacement orders, and warned of imminent strikes; this sustains a ceasefire violation pattern despite wider regional deal talk.

turkey.name: TURKEY-NATO
turkey.notes: No fresh Turkey-NATO trigger surfaced. Erdogan-Netanyahu rhetoric remains political spillover from Israeli actions, not a new Turkish-NATO escalation signal.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: Pakistan warned India river-flow restrictions could be an act of war, raising rhetoric risk; no fresh border force surge or major Kashmir clash was verified in the current scan.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Fresh live updates repeated Moscow messaging that Russia is ready to use nuclear weapons if threatened; no new Article 5 or direct NATO clash was found.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN

north_korea.name: DPRK

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: DW and regional reporting say Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant off-site power was cut again, while Russian strikes hit the Zaporizhzhia region and Ukraine war intensity remains extreme.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Fresh reports say Pakistan-Afghanistan border clashes killed five and Pakistan conducted airstrikes on Afghan territory, with Taliban-linked claims of child casualties keeping the border war track imminent.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Al Jazeera and Sudanese sources report RSF-attributed drone strikes around el-Obeid killing up to 23 and hitting residential/funeral/food-supply targets; Kordofan drone war is widening.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza strikes and deaths continued as Cairo-hosted ceasefire talks proceeded. The track remains imminent but not rising because diplomacy is active.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: No new credible 24h Abyei/South Sudan escalation found; older peacekeeper/clash items remain background only.

latest_news.headline: U.S.-Iran deal appears within reach
latest_news.text: BBC, NYT and Washington Post report a U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal is close; Iran says Hormuz reopening follows implementation. Risk falls, but the restricted Hormuz posture remains active until ships normalize.

latest_news.headline: Israel hits south Lebanon, orders displacement
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera reports one killed as Israel hit south Lebanon and issued forced-displacement orders; Al Arabiya says the Israeli military warned of imminent additional strikes.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan bombs Afghanistan again
latest_news.text: MSN-linked reporting and regional feeds say Pakistan conducted airstrikes on Afghan territory, with Taliban-linked claims that 13 were killed including children.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan calls India water blockade an act of war
latest_news.text: AnewZ reports Pakistan warned Indian river-flow restrictions could be an act of war, raising rhetoric risk even without a verified fresh border force surge.

latest_news.headline: Kim Yo Jong hardens atomic-programme line
latest_news.text: MSN-linked reporting says Kim Yo Jong called the atomic programme a line of no retreat; Yonhap reports South Korea, the U.S. and Japan held North Korea talks.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan stages coastal defense drill
latest_news.text: Asahi/Reuters-linked reporting says Taiwan simulated destroying an invading force in a coastal drill; ISW update shows continued pressure but no fresh PRC blockade trigger.
sources: Institute for the Study of War

latest_news.headline: Zaporizhzhia plant power cut off again
latest_news.text: DW reports Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant off-site power was cut; additional regional reporting says Russian strikes hit Zaporizhzhia, keeping nuclear-safety risk elevated.

latest_news.headline: Moscow nuclear-use rhetoric resurfaces
latest_news.text: MSN live updates repeated Moscow messaging that Russia is ready to use nuclear weapons if threatened; no fresh direct Russia-NATO clash was verified.

latest_news.headline: IAEA demands Iran reporting
latest_news.text: JNS and FDD-linked feeds report IAEA board action and analysis of Iran enrichment progress; U.S.-allied terms still require accounting for 60 percent enriched stockpiles.

latest_news.headline: Turkey spillover remains rhetorical
latest_news.text: Yeni Şafak and MSN feeds show Iran-war and Netanyahu-Erdogan rhetoric, but no fresh Turkey-NATO military escalation trigger surfaced.
